market_read: Week 5 snapshot: 19 verified rows (18 persisting, 1 new), 0 indicative. A new farm lot in Ilayang Atingay, Magdalena (14,182 sqm, PHP 21,273,000, PHP 1,500/sqm, no structures, river access, clean title) joins the dataset from an individually verified Dot Property post; all 18 prior listings retain identical asking prices for the fifth consecutive week. Verified range PHP 269–3,000/sqm; dataset median PHP 1,200/sqm, both unchanged. Pagsanjan-core median (8 rows) holds at PHP 975/sqm; ring median (11 rows) edges down from PHP 1,600 to PHP 1,500/sqm, reflecting the new mid-range Magdalena addition rather than any price reduction. No listing has publicly cleared in five weeks; asking-versus-clearing price evidence remains absent. For a raw 0.5–1 ha Pagsanjan parcel, the tightest comparables remain Maulawin (4,767 sqm, PHP 2,000/sqm) and Bulilan Norte/Pila (6,447 sqm, PHP 2,000/sqm), supporting an asking range of PHP 1,600–2,000/sqm; PHP 1,400/sqm remains the fastest-sale recommendation, unchanged from baseline.
